description: Machine-readable twin of repo/docs/HOST-CONTRACT.md: what the programme custody model needs from each supported host. Tests read this file against the shipped plugin hooks. It records needs and current mechanisms; it does not claim native qualification, which belongs to each host's own support work.

turn_end_hook.unbound_session: returns before any git, gh or network call
turn_end_hook.refresh: a session the after-tool hook marked starts programme.cjs refresh in the background for each governed checkout it wrote for, then clears the mark

after_tool_hook.effect: marks the session after a GitHub write (connector write tools, gh issue or pr writes, gh api writes, git push); no git, gh or network call

session_identity.status: observed; not in the host's environment-variable reference

codex.windows_command: commandWindows: full powershell.exe path, -File repo/scripts/toolkit-programme-checkpoint-hook.ps1 for the turn-end and after-tool hooks (setup adds it to the installed copy only)
codex.hook_trust: review and trust in /hooks; Codex skips an untrusted hook

session_identity.status: unverified: no documented way for the session to read its own ID

codex.route_read_back: session log, read by the lead

completion_modes.native: The executor binds its session; its turn-end hook journals checkpoints and returns, and the controller's reconcile folds them in.
completion_modes.toolkit_assisted: The executor reports in its thread or chat; the controller records the return with return --record.
completion_modes.unsupported: No custody path; the controller does not launch gate work on this host.

launch.duplicate_check: show --issue <n> before launching a gate; a live assignment holds the launch

handover: stop or fence the old writer
journals of the old assignment are stale and never replayed
limits: The fence orders cooperating Toolkit writers under one account; it authenticates nobody.
The tool cannot see whether another host session has stopped; a takeover record must carry that evidence.
